proof_requests: A photo of the front of the camera body clearly showing the 'D810' model badge.
Photos of the lens glass (front and back) without the lens cap.
A photo of the camera sensor with the lens detached.
A screenshot of the current shutter count.
A video of the camera operating and taking a photo.
response.reason: The specific model of the Nikon body is not visible in the report, making it impossible to establish even a base value. The condition of the lens glass and sensor is also hidden by the lens cap.
